Good to know

Questions, answered.

What can I open in TorrentPlayer?＋

TorrentPlayer opens local video files and .torrent files you choose. Its file picker supports common formats including MKV, MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM.

Does TorrentPlayer include a movie catalog?＋

No. TorrentPlayer is a player, not a content catalog. You bring your own local video or torrent file and remain responsible for using content you are authorized to access.

How does subtitle search work?＋

You can set a preferred language, use an IMDb ID for a more precise match, and configure supported providers such as SubDL and OpenSubtitles.

When will it be available?＋

TorrentPlayer is being prepared for the Mac App Store. This page will link directly to the store listing when it is live.

Support

Need help with TorrentPlayer?

Report an issue, describe what you opened, and include your macOS version so the problem can be reproduced.

Open the support tracker ↗
Responsible use

Your player, not a content catalog.

TorrentPlayer does not provide movies or a torrent discovery service. Only open media you own or are authorized to access. Subtitle searches use the provider settings you configure.
